# Matthew Payne Consulting

> High-trust, peer-to-peer client and investor growth for financial advisors, fund managers raising capital, and estate & business attorneys. Founded by Matthew Payne: twenty years of consulting, three thousand seminars and trainings, 325+ clients across 107 industries. Operations are powered by Jarvis, an agentic AI operator that runs research, qualification, outreach, follow-up, booking, and monitoring around the clock.

## Services

- [Financial advisors](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/advisor.html): High net worth and ultra high net worth client acquisition — the High-Net-Worth Client Attraction & Conversion System plus 1-on-1 weekly strategic marketing consulting, for financial advisors and wealth managers seeking HNW/UHNW clients and AUM growth.
- [VC & fund managers](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/vc.html): Capital raising — peer-to-peer, high-trust allocator and high net worth investor relationships for venture capital fund managers, GPs, and firms raising capital. Client raises include $100M, $60M, and $35M.
- [Estate & business attorneys](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/attorney.html): High net worth client acquisition systems for estate planning attorneys and business attorneys serving HNW families and business owners.
- [Jarvis — agentic technology](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/jarvis.html): The agentic AI operator behind Matthew Payne Consulting — an executive mind built as an extension of the professional it serves. Runs the full client-acquisition sequence around the clock: prospect research, qualification, outreach written in the client's own voice across email and LinkedIn, follow-up with perfect memory, meeting booking and pre-meeting briefings, CRM upkeep, campaign management, deliverability and pipeline monitoring, and a daily briefing. One operator with the output of a marketing team, a research analyst, and an assistant who never sleeps.
- The System (flagship online hybrid training): The High Net Worth Client & Investor Attraction & Conversion System — a structured online course plus live coaching, delivered to enrolled clients through the private course portal at https://portal.matthewpayneconsulting.com/. Covers premium client and investor targeting, LinkedIn Sales Navigator strategy, positioning, high-converting messaging, and call proficiency for advisors, fund managers, and attorneys.
- [The Owner's Manual to the Mind](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/audio/): Matthew Payne's free personal-development audio program — six sections, ten volumes, 95 tracks, over eight hours, recorded live and remastered in 2026. Covers the unconscious mind, mentality and perception, emotional mastery, overcoming procrastination, high performance living, and success habits. Section One is available by opting in with an email address.
- Optimal Performance Business & Life Coaching: Private one-on-one business and life coaching across psychology, strategy, habits, and energy, built on two decades of live performance psychology teaching.

## Guides

- [How Financial Advisors Get High-Net-Worth Clients](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-financial-advisors-get-high-net-worth-clients.html): Why wealthy families hire trust instead of responding to pitches, and how advisors build those relationships deliberately, peer to peer.
- [How to Grow AUM Without Cold Calling](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/grow-aum-without-cold-calling.html): The positioning cost of volume outreach with wealthy clients, and the network-building alternative that keeps an advisor's book exclusive by design.
- [How to Raise Capital Without a Placement Agent](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/raise-capital-without-a-placement-agent.html): Why placement agents pass on emerging managers, the problem with living on introductions, and how GPs build their own network of high-net-worth investors, family offices, and allocators.
- [How Emerging Fund Managers Find Investors](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-emerging-fund-managers-find-investors.html): Raising in a flight-to-quality market: conviction capital versus committee capital, peer-to-peer posture, and protecting scarcity through the raise.
- [How Estate Planning Attorneys Attract High-Net-Worth Clients](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/how-estate-attorneys-attract-high-net-worth-clients.html): How wealthy families actually choose estate counsel, why advertising fails at the top of the market, and building trust networks on purpose.
- [How Attorneys Grow Beyond Referrals](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/attorney-growth-beyond-referrals.html): The referral ceiling, why the usual marketing alternatives feel wrong for attorneys, and building a direct pipeline of wealthy families.
- [Are Capital Introduction Services Legit?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/are-capital-introduction-services-legit.html): The licensing test that separates registered placement agents from the gray market of paid intro services and investor lists, what unlicensed introductions can cost a fund, and the peer-to-peer alternative.
- [Why Investors Ghost Fund Managers](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/why-investors-ghost-fund-managers.html): Why silence after a good first meeting traces back to how the relationship started, what chasing costs a GP's scarcity, and the upstream fix: investors who discover the manager peer to peer.
- [Can AI Actually Book Meetings With High-Net-Worth Clients?](https://matthewpayneconsulting.com/can-ai-book-meetings-with-high-net-worth-clients.html): Why AI outreach volume fails on wealthy people, and how Jarvis, the agentic operator behind Matthew Payne Consulting, books real meetings by running the discipline behind peer-to-peer relationships.
